transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Hello, Doctor. I'm here because I've been feeling extremely depressed and sad almost constantly for the past four weeks. It just feels like this heavy, sunken mood won't go away.
In addition to these feelings of sadness, have you ever experienced periods lasting several days where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or productive, needing much less sleep than usual?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I have mostly just felt really down and constantly tired instead.
Have you ever experienced hearing voices, seeing things that others do not, or feeling as though people are watching or trying to harm you?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I don't hear or see things that aren't there, and I've never felt like anyone was watching or trying to hurt me.
Have you been feeling this way continuously for the last four weeks, or have you experienced similar feelings of low mood that have persisted for two years or longer?
Yes, I've been feeling this heavy, sunken mood continuously every day for the past four weeks. I definitely haven't experienced these feelings persisting for as long as two years, though.
During these past four weeks, have you found that you have lost interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?
Yes, I've completely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to enjoy. Absolutely nothing brings me any pleasure or joy anymore.
Besides your mood and loss of interest, have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or your sleep patterns during these past four weeks?
No, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or my sleep patterns over the past four weeks. They both seem to be pretty much the same as usual.
Have you been experiencing feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or difficulty concentrating during this time?

Yes, I've been feeling completely worthless and useless lately, and I constantly blame myself and feel intense guilt over minor things. I haven't really noticed any major issues with my concentration, as these heavy feelings of guilt and worthlessness seem to take up all my thoughts.

The absence of manic/hypomanic symptoms, psychotic features, or a chronic two-year history excludes Bipolar disorders, psychotic disorders, and Persistent Depressive Disorder, respectively. While sleep and appetite changes are not present, the core symptoms are sufficient to maintain the current candidate.
